name: Bevel
description: A small software product presented as a late nineties desktop: the window chrome is the layout, with a navigator tree and a document laid out as real panes, a keyboard operable tabbed inspector, a status bar, a taskbar and a drawn console. Every mark is SVG or a CSS gradient.
designNotes: Plotform adaptation of 7.css, not an unchanged upstream template, and without its icon images: every mark here is SVG drawn for the edition or a CSS gradient.

98.css and XP.css were checked first and rejected: both bundle a FontStruction of MS Sans Serif licensed CC BY-SA 3.0, which would pass a share alike obligation to everyone publishing from the edition. 7.css bundles no fonts at all, so this edition bundles Noto Sans, the open face its own stack falls back to.
The chrome is the layout: the navigator and the document are real panes of a grid, and at 320px the window drops its radius and borders and runs edge to edge rather than scrolling sideways.

The one interaction is a real tab widget with arrow, Home and End keys, correct roles and a visible focus ring. The illustrative product, its studio and its changelog are invented and marked as such on every page.
